title: A Unified Framework for Probability Estimation of Data-Dependent Events
abstract: arXiv:2610.41244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the general problem of estimating $D(\dde(S))$, the probability that an unknown distribution $D$ assigns to an event determined by a sample $S$ of $n$ i.i.d.\ draws from $D$ through a known mapping $\dde$. The estimation algorithm knows $\dde$ and $S$ but does not have access to any additional samples from $D$. This formulation captures classical missing mass, the data-dependent targets of adaptive data analysis and post-selection inference, and the test error of a data-trained predictor, whose estimation was recently studied by \new{Gastpar et al.\ (2024a,b)}. Within this framework we examine the two classical approaches to estimation. The error of the empirical plug-in estimator is exactly a generalization gap, so generalization bounds transfer to it directly. translated_title: 数据依赖事件概率估计的统一框架
translated_abstract: 我们研究估计 $D(\dde(S))$ 的一般性问题，即未知分布 $D$ 赋予某一事件的概率，该事件由来自 $D$ 的 $n$ 个独立同分布样本 $S$ 通过已知映射 $\dde$ 所确定。估计算法知道 $\dde$ 和 $S$，但无法获得来自 $D$ 的任何额外样本。这一表述涵盖了经典的缺失质量（missing mass）问题、自适应数据分析和后选择推断中的数据依赖目标，以及数据训练预测器的测试误差，后者的估计最近由 Gastpar 等人（2024a,b）研究。在该框架内，我们考察了两种经典的估计方法。经验代入（plug-in）估计器的误差恰好是一个泛化差距，因此泛化界限可以直接迁移到它上面。留一（leave-one-out）估计器可恢复出 Good–Turing 估计器，对于每一个在删除单个样本点下保持稳定的映射都是准确的，包括 ne…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一框架来估计由样本数据经映射决定的事件概率，该框架同时涵盖缺失质量、自适应数据分析目标与模型测试误差等经典问题，并证明了代入估计器的误差恰为泛化差距、留一估计器对稳定映射均准确。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework for estimating the probability of events determined by samples through a known mapping—subsuming missing mass, adaptive data analysis targets, and test error—and shows that the plug-in estimator's error is exactly a generalization gap while the leave-one-out estimator is accurate for all deletion-stable mappings.
